title: ACME Conductor SignedCertificateReconcileResult v1alpha1
description: A CertificateReconcileResult wrapped in a signed, expiring envelope, signed by the Runner that produced it (JWS construction, RFC 7515 with the EdDSA algorithm of RFC 8037): 'signature' is the Ed25519 signature over the ASCII bytes of 'protected', a period, and 'payload'. 'protected' is the base64url (unpadded) JSON header {alg, kid, issuedAt, expiresAt, nonce}; 'payload' is the base64url (unpadded) Result document exactly as the Runner serialized it. A Conductor configured with Runner public keys accepts only such envelopes, so a writer to the shared transport cannot substitute or alter a Result; correlation to the run is checked after verification. Go validation (pkg/api/v1alpha1/signedresult.go) is authoritative and stricter than this schema: it decodes and checks the header, verifies the signature against trusted keys, and enforces the validity window.

protected.description: base64url (no padding) of the JSON protected header. Decoded, it is a strict JSON object {"alg":"EdDSA","kid":"<16 lower-case hex>","issuedAt":<RFC 3339>,"expiresAt":<RFC 3339>,"nonce":"<16..128 base64url chars>"} with no other members; expiresAt must be after issuedAt and at most 24 hours later.

payload.description: base64url (no padding) of the CertificateReconcileResult document (result.schema.json), at most 65536 bytes decoded.

signature.description: base64url (no padding) of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature.
